bioconda.name: aastore
bioconda.summary: Compact protein sequence storage with batched random and sequential access
bioconda.description:
RabbitAAStore combines continuous 5-bit protein sequence encoding, compact
indexing, configurable preloading, and batched disk access. This package
provides its Python API and compiled C++ core, with runtime SIMD dispatch
and automatic fallback from io_uring to pread when io_uring is unavailable.
